THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
096
Behind the image
71 / Gold Laurel
REFERENCE 5851.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 051
Art direction: Antique gold and silver against warm honey tones, dramatic eye makeup, a soft glow
in the background.
Photorealistic vertical runway close-up portrait of an original adult woman with very long,
honey-brown hair parted in the center and falling in soft waves, a gold leaf crown across the top of
her head, pale blue-gray eyes with dramatic smoky graphic eyeliner, defined brows and soft peach
lips. She wears a sheer silver tulle neckline with sequined and beaded lace over a bodice, and small
gold drop earrings. Warm, softly blurred background in amber and deep red, soft frontal runway
light, shallow depth of field, antique gold and silver palette, regal couture mood, sharp detail on
the crown, no text or logos.
72 / Sage Tweed
REFERENCE 5934.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 052
Art direction: Soft sage and cream against a warm amber stage glow, clean runway framing and a
poised, neutral walk.
Photorealistic full-length vertical runway photograph of an original adult woman with long, wavy
copper-red hair framing her face, a poised neutral expression and fresh pale lips, walking toward
the camera. She wears a fitted pale sage tweed mini dress with a sweetheart neckline, patch
pockets and small pearl buttons, layered over a white shirt with a voluminous white satin bow at
the collar and sheer white cape sleeves. White knee-high socks, pointed white slingback heels, and
a single pale peach ranunculus held in one hand. Warm amber stage backdrop, soft spotlight from
above, slightly textured concrete runway floor, pastel sage and cream palette, crisp tweed texture,
contemporary runway editorial, no text or logos.
